title: PhD Programs, 2027-28 Fall Intake
institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
about: HKUST (Guangzhou) accepts PhD applications for its 2027-28 fall intake from 21 July 2026; the deadline is 15 June 2027 for international applicants and 15 July 2027 for Chinese applicants. Offers are made on a rolling basis; classes start 1 September 2027.
